verdict.rationale: Custom frameworks and controls are a fair question for a compliance automation platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only built-in framework coverage (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) and pre-mapped controls. Nothing documents creating custom frameworks, custom controls, custom tests or custom evidence requirements. Custom fields in the AI Systems configuration are an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones
